d: China has launched its Shenzhou-24 crewed spacecraft, carrying Pakistani astronaut Muhammad Zeeshan Ali in a historic first for China's space programme. Ali becomes the first foreign national to travel aboard a Chinese spacecraft and visit its space station. The mission marks the first joint spaceflight involving Chinese and foreign astronauts, highlighting growing China-Pakistan cooperation under Beijing's Belt and Road Initiative.
